comment: Horde after a long real-time fight (user request 2026-10-06, UE-only; Combat/HordeRules.h, UHordeSubsystem). The clock counts only fight time in full real time (not the tactical pause, not turn-based combat, not dialogues / cutscenes) and restarts with every fight (each wave, an ambush fight). Per level: the level JSON "horde_enabled": false switches it off, an optional "horde": { ...same keys... } overrides these values. Distances in meters, times in seconds. composition = weights per level-JSON enemy type (HOUND / FROST_HOUND, FROSTBITTEN, BRUTE, SPITTER, CUTTER, MARKSMAN, CRYO_DRONE). Console: Codex.Horde.TriggerSeconds / Codex.Horde.RepeatSeconds / Codex.Horde.Enabled (-1 = data), CodexTactics.Horde.Release.
